content: 1. The combination of meclizine and botulinum toxin A may enhance the effects of the toxin through pharmacodynamic synergy. This could lead to excessive neuromuscular weakness and increased systemic anticholinergic effects. Close monitoring is advised. 2. Drugs with anticholinergic properties can amplify the effects of botulinum toxin, potentially causing significant neuromuscular weakness and heightened systemic anticholinergic effects. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 3. Meclizine and medications such as meclizine and desflurane, desipramine, or dexchlorpheniramine can increase sedation when used together.
